name: Detmold (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Detmold (a white castle with a rose on red).
history: Municipal flag of Detmold; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Detmold arms — white castle with rose on red
